name: @nexus/web-e2e
description: Nexus web/desktop/ui forced-failure e2e suite (EP-033 M4): composes the REAL @nexus/web contracts, @nexus/desktop runtime/dispatcher, and @nexus/ui React components and proves fail-closed behavior under corrupted messages, denied policy, duplicate requests, expired/revoked sessions, unavailable backends, secret-leak attempts, and context switches. Production components are never mocked; controlled inputs are the failure mechanism.
